name: Cosmic Web
desc: The large-scale structure of the universe rendered as a dark-matter simulation slice — luminous filaments of galaxies strung between massive halo nodes, threading around vast black voids, the whole web slowly shearing and drifting under gravity while the brightest clusters twinkle.

density.doc: halo count + filament particle load (structure richness)

energy.doc: brightness / exposure of the density field + glints

drift.doc: how far halos wander (filament writhe amplitude)
